rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing or saying something openly or publicly.

example.english: We will openly voice our opinions about this decision.
example.traditional: 我哋會公開講出對呢個決定嘅意見。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 gung1 hoi1 gong2 ceot1 deoi3 ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 ge3 ji3 gin3

rows.note: Use this when the action happens openly in front of other people or an audience.

example.english: He openly proposed to his girlfriend in front of everyone.
example.traditional: 佢竟然當眾向女朋友求婚。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ging2 jin4 dong1 zung3 hoeng3 neoi5 pang4 jau5 kau4 fan1

rows.note: Use this when “openly” also suggests acting brazenly or without shame, usually negatively.

example.english: That thief openly stole things right on the street.
example.traditional: 嗰個賊明目張膽咁喺街上面偷嘢。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 caak2 ming4 muk6 zoeng1 daam2 gam3 hai2 gaai1 soeng6 min6 tau1 je5
